verdict.rationale: Copilot's own memory feature can store specific facts users ask it to remember and use them to make later responses more relevant (copilot-docs-32), and it feeds into personalized suggestions (copilot-docs-33). This gives some persistent personalization, but the evidence never shows a dedicated custom-instructions or preferences setting that shapes every response. Missing for 10: a documented persistent custom-instructions/system-preference field, evidence that stored memory applies to every response rather than only 'relevant' ones, controls to view or edit stored preferences, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
